content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Recruitment 2026 Overview

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhopal has announced a total of 2 vacancies for Project Research Scientist-II posts. One vacancy is for the Medical category and one is for the Non-Medical category.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a separate application closing date.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the educational qualification, experience and age requirements specified for the respective Medical or Non-Medical post. Candidates applying for Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) must meet any one of the following qualification requirements: MBBS, BVSc or BDS with three years of post-qualification experience. MBBS, BVSc or BDS with a postgraduate degree such as MD, MVSc, MDS, MPH or an equivalent degree, including integrated postgraduate degrees. MBBS, BVSc or BDS with PhD. Experience in NCD-related research projects and work in disease modelling will be preferred for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post. Candidates applying for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) must meet either of the following requirements: Postgraduate degree, including integrated postgraduate degrees, with three years of post-qualification experience or PhD. For Engineering, IT or Computer Science candidates, a four-year graduate degree with three years of post-qualification experience. For the Non-Medical post, experience working with R, Python or other programming languages for developing web applications, simulations or dashboards relevant to the project will be preferred. Educational qualifications and certificates must be from a recognized Board or University. Relevant experience will be counted after completion of the minimum essential qualification. Experience from government organizations is preferred. Experience from reputed national or international organizations may also be considered.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for both Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) and Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) posts is 40 years. The age eligibility will be calculated as on 12 October 2026. Age relaxation is admissible to SC, ST and OBC candidates, retrenched government employees, departmental candidates including project employees, and ex-servicemen according to Central Government instructions. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in research projects may also be admissible to experienced and skilled persons.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Medical post offers monthly remuneration of Rs. 80,000 plus 20% HRA, totaling Rs. 96,000. The Non-Medical post offers Rs. 67,000 plus 20% HRA, totaling Rs. 80,400 per month.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure depends on the number of applicants received for each post. A written test will be conducted if the number of applicants for a single post exceeds 30. Scrutiny of applications and eligibility. Shortlisting of candidates, where applicable. Screening written test, if required. Interview. Final selection based on the applicable selection criteria. If a written test is conducted, a maximum of five candidates will normally be shortlisted for the interview based on written-test scores. If fewer than five candidates obtain the qualifying score, all qualifying candidates will be shortlisted. In case of a tie in written-test marks, the candidate with the earlier date of birth will be ranked higher. If a written test is conducted, final selection will be based on the combined written-test and interview scores. If no written test is required, selection will be based exclusively on interview scores. When a large number of applications are received, candidates may be shortlisted based on: Relevant experience exceeding the minimum requirement. Higher educational qualifications than the prescribed minimum. Publications in PubMed-indexed journals.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Written Test Pattern
content_sections.text: If a screening written test is required, it will consist of 50 multiple-choice questions. The test may cover: NCD Epidemiology Health Economics Cost-Effectiveness Analysis Disease Modelling and Simulation Biostatistics Research Methodology General Aptitude Interview questions may focus on: NCD Epidemiology Health Economics Cost-Effectiveness Analysis Disease Modelling and Microsimulation Biostatistics Research Methodology Project Management

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Interview Venue
content_sections.text: The interview venue mentioned in the notification is: CFM Board Room, Second Floor, Medical College Building, AIIMS Bhopal. The notification also states that the date and time of the written test or interview are tentative and communication regarding the selection process will be sent to shortlisted candidates through email. Candidates should also check the AIIMS Bhopal website for updates.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates should bring the filled application form along with the required supporting documents. Filled application form Curriculum Vitae (CV) Recent photograph Proof of date of birth, such as Class 10 certificate or school leaving certificate Educational qualification mark sheets Degree certificates Experience certificates Caste certificate, if applicable Registration certificate with the statutory council, if applicable Other relevant testimonials Original documents for verification Self-attested photocopies of required documents Coloured passport-size photographs Candidates employed in government organizations or other funded research projects must provide a No Objection Certificate from their employer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a separate online application process or a separate application closing date.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Project Research Scientist-II Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointments are purely contractual and temporary under an externally funded project. The initial tenure is one year and may be extended depending on performance and approval of the project duration by the funding agency. The contractual appointment does not provide any claim to a regular post at AIIMS Bhopal or the funding agency. Candidates must provide correct information regarding qualification and experience. Incomplete or incorrect applications may be rejected. A valid email ID and mobile number are mandatory for communication. No TA or DA will be provided for attending the test or interview. Candidates may be posted at rural or field sites depending on project requirements. AIIMS Bhopal will not provide accommodation. Canvassing or submission of false information may result in disqualification.
